consequence.statement: Environments using OpenShift profile variants (e.g., profile=ambient-openshift) must migrate to --set profile=ambient --set global.platform=openshift; the old profile variants are no longer supported.

original.statement: OpenShift profile variants for Helm installs are removed and replaced with global.platform=openshift configuration; a new global.platform Helm value enables platform-specific configurations.

decision.reason: The assertion's subject is the global.platform Helm value, but the proposed migration-required consequence describes a different change bundled into the same note: the removal of the OpenShift profile variants [ev-d6ef50aec061]. Using global.platform is opt-in, so it does not by itself require anyone to migrate. The validator also refuted the "added" change, because global.platform already exists in the 1.23.4 values [ev-41d780f6ab39, ev-ad95ec08c00b]. For the profile removal, the note only says the variants are "replaced with global.platform overrides". It does not say whether an install still using profile=ambient-openshift fails, is rejected or keeps working. That removal should be its own item, with its consequence left undetermined until evidence states the outcome.
